This project takes users on an interactive exploration into the writings of the Founding Fathers. Features will include visualizations of when, where, and between whom information was communicated during the Founding era of American history – correspondence and topic networks, timelines, spatial maps – as well as fully customizable query functionality to search for specific phrases, content matter, or entire documents. 

Currently working on figuring out (free) public deployment options!
